zone2Long.title: Zone 2

cardio.where: Incline treadmill, stairmaster or a hilly trail

zone2Long.intervalsHow: In the middle of the Zone 2 session, on a steep incline treadmill or hill. 3 min easy between reps. No pack.

testDriftVertical.title: Drift test and vertical test
testDriftVertical.instructions:
Drift test: use a chest strap, not a wrist sensor. On a flat treadmill or a flat loop, build up over 15 min to an easy effort, then hold a steady pace for 60 min while recording heart rate. Note your starting HR and the average HR of the first and second 30 min.
Vertical test: 60 min on the stairmaster or incline treadmill at a fixed incline (e.g. 15%) with a 10 kg pack, at a steady Zone 2. Record vertical metres and average HR. Do both under the same conditions in week 1 and week 12.

testThreshold.title: Threshold test
testThreshold.instructions: After the warm-up, 30 min hard, steady effort on the incline treadmill or uphill, on a different day from the drift test. Log the average heart rate as your threshold HR; it approximates your anaerobic threshold. Then easy Zone 2 until the session reaches about 60 min.

testDriftRetest.title: Drift retest
testDriftRetest.instructions: Your intervals are still off, so repeat the drift test: chest strap, flat treadmill or loop, 15 min build-up to an easy effort, then 60 min at a steady pace. Note your starting HR and the average HR of each 30-min half. The threshold gap is recalculated with your latest threshold result.

longDayTest.title: Long-day test
longDayTest.instructions: 5 h hike with a 12–14 kg pack on the hilliest route you can reach, including a real descent. You're ready for multi-day treks if you finish feeling you could do it again the next day.
